Hi all — glad we could find a few overlapping windows. We run a 45-minute evening office-hours format (20–25 minute demo + 20-minute breakout Q&A) that works well for cross-team groups. I attached a short agenda and an .ics for the main bridge.

Quick asks so we can finalize the roster:
- Preferred date/time from the three options in the ICS? (Wed 12/3 5pm PT, Thu 12/4 6pm PT, Mon 12/8 4pm PT)
- Rough headcount and any compliance attendees (SOC/Audit) who need a separate breakout
- Any specific workloads you want us to show (batch embeddings, low-latency chat, private deployment)

Capacity note: we cap the main demo at 40 attendees and keep a 10-person standby list. If we hit waitlist, we open parallel breakout rooms prioritized by deal motion. Ben will own the bridge run; Marissa will run breakouts.

Attaching: MVP-Agenda.pdf, roundhouse-bridge.ics

If you reply with your preferred slot I’ll lock it and share the final calendar.

Thanks —

Emma — perfect, locking Thu 12/4 6pm PT for RetailCo. Answering your two Qs inline: 

1) Main-room prioritization: we prioritize by deal stage and active participants (sales/SE flagged in HubSpot). If multiple accounts are in the same stage, we rotate main-room access across the waitlist and open a second breakout with a live host (Marissa) so no one misses the demo content. We’ll post a short note at T‑10 explaining where people should join.
2) Recording: yes — we record the main demo and share the recording and slides within 24 hours. Compliance-only breakout recordings are not shared externally without agreement.

Operational notes for internal team:
- Ben: you own the bridge + recording (confirm mic check at 5:30pm PT).
- Marissa: host and moderate breakout rooms; prioritize SOC/compliance and any private-deploy questions.
- Laura: please prepare a light billing/commit cheat-sheet to drop in the follow-up doc (cc’d).

Forwarding Emma’s availability below for visibility. Emma — when you confirm headcount next Monday we’ll add the attendees to the invite and publish a waitlist link.
